description: An HTML file containing embedded JavaScript code for cross-window communication, including URL parameter parsing and periodic data sending to a parent frame.

methods.name: gup
methods.description: Extracts a specified query parameter value from the current URL.

methods.name: sendData2Master
methods.description: Sends data to the master window if available and clears the interval.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Initializes periodic data sending when the document loads.
